item.title: Foggy Start, Warm Weekend With Storms Late Sunday, Cold Air Blast Into Next Week
item.description: WBBJ 7 Forecast Update: A dense fog advisory until 10 this Saturday morning. Use caution through the morning as the visibility is very low through west Tennessee and surrounding areas. Low beam headlights will help some, but in many cases, you’ll have to slow down. The fog should burn off around the 10 am hour. Skies will be partly cloudy...

item.title: Man accused of 1996 Tupac Shakur killing seeks to suppress evidence
item.description: The attorneys for the man accused of killing rap icon Tupac Shakur in 1996 are pushing to suppress evidence obtained in what they claim was an "unlawful nighttime search."

item.title: Federal judge to hold hearing on whether Kilmar Abrego Garcia is being vindictively prosecuted
item.description: A federal judge this week canceled the trial of Kilmar Abrego Garcia, the Salvadoran man who was mistakenly deported, and scheduled a hearing on whether the prosecution is being vindictive in pursuing a human smuggling case against him.
